To verify the structural integrity of the handle connection and ensure the rim is a closed, continuous loop without melting or fusion artifacts.
There is legible text on the milk carton in the background ('Whole Milk', 'Vitamin D'). This expert will check for text gibberish or rendering errors which are common AI artifacts.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the coffee foam or ceramic glaze.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the cup body; AI often fails here by merging the handle into the wall or leaving a gap. Also, scrutinize the text on the background milk carton—AI frequently generates plausible-looking but nonsensical lettering. Check if the coffee liquid surface interacts realistically with the cup walls (meniscus).
